lang.string: To my son, Today you complete your [color=#DAA520FF]sixteen winters[/color]. As tradition dictates, today you must prove you have a hand for the craft. If you want to cross this door again, start with the first task: [color=#B22222]Let the forge breathe.[/color] The fire is asleep. To awaken it, look for the coal stored in three small barrels around the garden. Manage on your own and show me you can fend for yourself. - Your father

Not all that is useful shines, nor is everything long a spear.
The handle you seek is not far, it only hides among its sisters: [color=#DAA520FF]long, wooden, and sharp-tipped.[/color]
Look closely. One of them was not born to wound, but to give breath to the fire.
Hmmm... It seems the bellows is missing the handle to work.

If you’ve made it this far, you already know you’re not alone. There is a large man wandering these halls. If he sees you, he will follow you. And if he reaches you, you won’t get any farther. Corners and shadows will be your best allies. Make noise far from yourself, and he will walk toward the echo.
Now, open your eyes wide. That tree holds more than fruit. Look up… What you seek rests among the branches, but it cannot be brought down by hand: make it fall with a well-thrown stone.
Only then will you be able to ignite what is missing.
